entries.d: Rename the LSP symbol with a live preview of every change
entries.n: Space c r types :IncRename <cword> for you; with Noice's inc_rename preset the command line appears as a small popup above the cursor. Edit the name and watch all occurrences update (highlighted Substitute); Enter renames across files, Esc cancels. An empty name cancels the preview.

notes.lead: Verified in plugin source and, where marked, by running the real config headless.
rows: obsidian.nvim's smart action (buffer-local) shadows the global Leap <kbd>Enter</kbd> and turns plain lines into checkboxes.
Snacks confirms with git checkout: detached HEAD (Space g l) or overwriting the file (Space g f, Space g L).
